title: The unfinished handoff
body: Two keys are taped to separate collection times. A bottle marked for the passenger has no return mark, though the driver’s sheet says every seat was cleared.
rival_reading: A household move or field visit could explain the keys and bottle; the completed seat sheet does not prove an evacuation failed.
gloss: A passenger’s bottle is left behind despite a completed seat record.

title: Kept from the drawer
body: The room smells like the liquid from the field bottles, and Mom’s throat still hurts. I opened the window; the return truck says nothing spilled.
rival_reading: A cleanup crew may have used disinfectant after an emergency; the letter does not establish what liquid caused the irritation.
gloss: A family member links a lingering illness to a field bottle smell, while a return note denies a spill.
